newsitem.title: CHINA: China to invest 19.4 bln yuan in coal industry.
newsitem.headline: China to invest 19.4 bln yuan in coal industry.

text.p: China plans to invest 19.435 billion yuan in construction of the coal industry and another 897 million yuan in technical improvements during 1997, an official of the Ministry of Coal Industry said on Tuesday.
The investment would be used to develop 55 mines with a total production capacity of 108.4 million tonnes a year and to conduct 46 technical upgrade projects this year, the official said.
China's coal output reached 1.374 billion tonnes in 1996, compared with 1.29 billion tonnes in 1995, another ministry official said without giving further details.
